correctness.rationale: Substitution in F(n) gives G_0(t)=t(3t−1)^2(3t−2)/4 and G_2(t)=t(3t+2)(3t+1)^2/4, reducing as polynomials to unit-slope t and −t. Their divided differences are units, so each contributes exactly one input per target modulo every 3^k. For n=3t+1, G_1=−3φ(t)^2/4 with φ=t√(1−9t²) using the square root congruent to 1 mod 3. The difference of two such roots is in 9(t−s)Z_3 by the difference of squares and unit sum, so φ is an isometry and permutes every finite level. For 3|y, the lower-depth square equation has three lifts per root (also k=1); otherwise none. For minimality, the mod-three sequence has a period of nine but not three, so an arbitrary period is divisible by nine (periods of the cyclic word are a subgroup). Evaluating at that period T gives v_3(F(T))=v_3(T)−1. The square-root classification by unit and even valuation gives the histogram, including the single zero target, and the critical image measure is (3/8)/3=1/8. The regular branches give total valuation density 4/3^(j+2); the critical branch gives 2/3^(r+2) at j=2r+1, with natural density by periodic cylinders. Fresh direct evaluation through k=8 matched all target counts and proper-divisor obstructions; replay /workspace/branches/f1125559-1aa8-4894-9018-c28d623d7353/record3_direct_check.py and record3_direct_check.out in the same directory.
